description:
# Sail Among the Tall Ships: 90-Minute Harbor Sail on Schooner Adirondack

Feel the wind fill the sails and the sea come alive beneath you as you embark on a true maritime adventure aboard the schooner Adirondack — Boston’s premier sailing vessel. During the Sail Boston® 2026 celebration, this 90-minute sail offers something no motor yacht can: the chance to actually sail among the world’s most magnificent tall ships as they grace our harbor.

Step aboard at Rowes Wharf and experience the harbor as sailors have for centuries — powered purely by the wind, surrounded by the towering masts and billowing sails of visiting vessels from across the globe.

# Why This Sail Is the Most Exciting Way to Experience the Tall Ships

You’re Not Just Watching — You’re Sailing: Unlike a traditional harbor cruise, you’ll feel the schooner heel gently under the breeze, trim the sails, and move in rhythm with the fleet — becoming part of the maritime spectacle itself.

Unobstructed, Open-Air Views: Adirondack’s classic deck design keeps every seat close to the water and the action. From your spot on deck, you’ll have panoramic views of Boston’s skyline and the international tall ships sailing nearby.

Skip the Crowds: Leave the congested waterfront behind and join a smaller, more personal voyage on the harbor. There’s no better way to see the ships than from the water — under sail, in peace.

Comfort and Charm: Adirondack is a 65-foot wooden schooner, built in the spirit of the 1890s racing yachts — fast, graceful, and comfortable. She’s known for smooth sailing and plenty of room for relaxation.

Drinks on Deck: A full bar offering beer, wine, and soft drinks is available for purchase, so you can toast to the international gathering as you sail among it.

About the Tall Ship Celebration

Sail Boston® 2026 (July 11–16, 2026) marks Boston’s participation in the global Sail250® celebration — honoring 250 years of American history and seamanship. The harbor will welcome an extraordinary fleet of tall ships and naval vessels from around the world for one of the most impressive maritime events in the nation.

# Select Visiting Vessels

* Amerigo Vespucci – Italy
* Bluenose II – Canada
* Cisne Branco – Brazil
* Juan Sebastián de Elcano – Spain
* Esmeralda – Chile
* Dar Młodzieży – Poland
* Denis Sullivan – USA

…and many more from across the globe.

# Why This Sail Is the Smart Ticket

* Authentic Sailing Adventure: Glide silently under sail among the international fleet — an experience few will ever have.

* Best Photo Opportunities: Capture the tall ships’ masts, rigging, and flags from sea level as you move among them.

* Exclusive and Intimate: Smaller passenger count means a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and personalized experience.

* No Engines, No Crowds, No Stress: Just the sound of wind, water, and canvas — and front-row views of one of the greatest maritime celebrations in the world.
